title: Lookup after dropping a prefix
statement: Let $y$ and $rest$ be Boolean words, and let $p$ and $i$ be natural numbers. If dropping the first $p-1$ entries of $y$ gives $rest$, then the optional entry of $y$ at index $p-1+i$ equals the optional entry of $rest$ at index $i$.
hypotheses_covered: dropping the first $p-1$ entries of $y$ gives $rest$
